{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Remove the temporary revenue_numeric column
df_clean = df_clean.drop(columns=['revenue_numeric'])

# Now, check the number of rows after removing QA orders
print("Total rows after removing QA orders:", len(df_clean))"}
